identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.17: a second selection scene (Config.Selection.scene = 2, a forest clearing with a pose per character, animals kept away), a much smaller download (rco-creator about 7 MB) and makeup colors in the menu taken from the game's palette. Also: new_character_only_direct spawn mode, better seated poses in the mansion, and fixes for the loading spinner, invisible players and missing hair in the selection.

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.121: jerry cans (Config.JerryCan). Fill one at any pump, from the pump's hint (E) or from the inventory, and pour it into a vehicle that ran dry; one item that keeps its litres in its metadata (default), or two items, empty and full, on RSG and VORP. Also: fuel pumps sit on the ground where a station's coords were taken high. 0.1.116: vehicles only some jobs can buy (Config.JobVehicles), trunks shown in the dealer. Add the jerry can item and its pictures: see the docs.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.92: more than one gym. Config.Gyms lists them (Strawberry comes ready, with its blip and record board); add one anywhere station by station, its type and the spot the player stands on, and the script lays its equipment out. Config.Blip moved into each gym's entry. 0.0.91: the pulley costs less while you train (the rope's pieces ride on its first one, only the last slides), the weight stacks and the hand bone are not asked again when nothing changed. 0.0.90: lighter for players watching someone train (the pulley ropes are drawn only by the one using it, equipment in another player's hands moved with less work, followed 10 times a second while he is off screen, who trains where read as it changes); the first-visit tips show once, one at a time. 0.0.89: skipping rope: every pass of the rope under the feet is a jump (a pass before the first one used to lose the rep). 0.0.88: new skipping rope minigame (the rope seen side on, it sweeps under the feet); tiredness as a bar, red when worn out, on the load picker and the record board; the horizontal ladder and the rope climb give less experience (Config.Progression.EasyShare). 0.0.87: any human character can train, server ped models too (the muscle on the body stays on the multiplayer bodies). 0.0.86: a set counts only from 5 good reps (Config.Progression.MinReps). 0.0.85: the record board and the load picker take the UI focus. 0.0.83: the exercises' animations play again. 0.0.82: the gym on the map (Config.Blip). 0.0.81: first release. A working 1890 gymnasium in Strawberry: 21 exercises on our own equipment, each with its own minigame; strength per muscle group with the muscle on the body (RCO Appearance, RSG Appearance or VORP Character); fatigue, warm-up and strains; wind for stamina and a harder punch; records, the week's champion and a spotter who can save your rep.
